steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Gate. Each service's combined attainment is checked against its target.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Week with missing records
findings.fix: Add the missing records and recompute

outcome.notChecked: Quality of the work done within target.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] sla-returns.csv:12  Combined attainment below its target.
       Fix: Recover the week's backlog.
[medium] sla-billing.csv:19  Week with missing records.
       Fix: Add the missing records and recompute.
[low] sla-audit.csv:26  Quality within target not measured.
       Fix: Add a quality check.
Not checked: Quality of the work done within target.
pros: Checks a combination below its target, and a week with missing records.
cons: Not checked: Quality of the work done within target.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-ops-weekly-sla-report skill on the records for this review.
